scene.note: Geometry in page points, top-left origin: the crop is the map image's placement; a quarter turn counter-clockwise stands it upright; the grid block is one drawn hex of its lattice, upright (w across corners, h across flats), centred on a hex centre near the middle; the distance is the map's smallest hex scale. Places stand at their hex centres; a site drawn across hexes at its label's hex.
